check.template: Run `make check` in this project and report the results. Do not modify any files unless asked.

lint.template: Run `make lint` in this project, show the full output, and summarize any issues found. Do not fix anything unless asked.

lint:fix.template: Run `npm run lint:fix` in this project to automatically fix lint issues. Report what was changed.

format.template: Run `make format` in this project to format the codebase. Report what was changed.

validate.template: Run `make validate` in this project and report the results. Do not modify files unless asked.

build.template: Run `make video-bg-play.zip` in this project to build the extension package. Report the build output and any artifacts created.
